starter_files.contents:
# RESTful API Service

Build a structured API for managing users, products, or tasks.

## Required features

- CRUD endpoints
- JSON request and response handling
- Request validation
- Middleware
- Structured errors and graceful shutdown

## Topics
net/http, handlers, routing, structs, interfaces, context, JSON, and testing.

## Setup and verification
Install a supported Go release, use a module, run `gofmt -w .`, `go test ./...`, `go vet ./...`, and the relevant security checks. No production credentials are needed for the starter. For database/network stages, use a local or test environment and inject configuration through environment variables.

## Status
Starter scaffold only. Complete every milestone, add tests and document actual commands before treating the project as finished.

stretch_features: Add table-driven tests for error paths and boundary cases.
Add a small architecture decision note with one trade-off.
Add a reproducible build and dependency/security review.

tests.name: Functional acceptance
criteria: Every required feature has observable evidence.
Normal, malformed, boundary, and failure cases are considered.
The application does not report success when an operation fails.

tests.name: Security review
criteria: Input validation, authorization, resource bounds, and safe logging are reviewed.

tests.name: Reproducibility
criteria: Setup commands work in a clean environment.
Tests, configuration requirements, and deployment steps are documented.

review_method: automated checks plus human review; no isolated arbitrary-code runner is assumed
status_note: Project outline and starter scaffold; complete and review the solution before publication.
